answer: Names are cheap to invent and dear to register, which is exactly the split that stops a farm. The forge is that the bill for trying is 70 separate visits, each one billed £22 at the door, due at the door for every name. No Sampled corn dealer manifest writ, no seat: the rule is plain, and a writ dealers sign after sack audits is why it holds. Every spiral is counted once. One atlas, one entry.
